prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a sunlit open-air stone terrace at midday with a pale paved floor, a waist-high balustrade, potted palms and a standard-height doorway, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Spanish woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, dramatic winged liner, a deep red lip, a passionate expression, warm olive skin, soft rose-gold hair styled in long locs gathered loosely, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long bronze chain ending in one large faceted topaz drop, and on the other ear a large copper hoop carrying four heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on copper chains of different lengths (a copper round bell, a lead teardrop-shaped sinker, a gold small flared temple bell, a bronze square-sided cowbell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and a single platinum bracelet. Extra long nails in matching polished walnut wood.
LEFT Physique: a stunning hourglass figure, far more dramatically curved than any ordinary woman; a full, rounded bust, a dramatically narrow, sharply cinched waist with a deep shadowed groove running around her middle, and wide, curvaceous hips flaring well beyond her shoulders, soft rounded thighs, toned but soft arms; not thin, not androgynous, not boyish, not a straight figure; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Body Art: full body rich dark walnut wood carved directly over her own form wrapping her whole body from the collarbones to the ankles, both legs carved all the way down to the ankles — this is solid carved wood curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into dozens of fitted carved sections whose grain changes direction from one section to the next, each joint standing in a thin raised ridge catching its own soft glint and casting its own small shadow, every section standing proud of the next. Dense fitted sections — BLAZING deep warm-brown walnut grain across the full torso and both legs down to the ankles, VIVID honey-gold highlight streaks running between the carved sections, polished to a warm satin sheen, completely opaque, with a deep three-dimensional carved surface. Her face and ears are real living skin, and her neck, from under the jaw down to the base of the neck, is bare real skin with visible pores and a soft natural sheen; the carved body starts exactly at the base of the neck, and her shoulders, chest, belly with its navel, arms, hands, wrists, legs and ankles are all carved rich dark walnut wood.

LEFT Cracks: the rich dark walnut wood body shows weathering in only two places: one bold, clearly visible crack running across her left shoulder, and one chipped-off piece at her left hip, where the broken edge reveals the pale raw fresh wood with a rough splintered grain, much lighter than the dark polished outside inside. Everywhere else, including her bust, the rich dark walnut wood is smooth, polished and whole, and her face, ears and neck are living skin.
LEFT Pose: classical contrapposto stance, weight on one leg, one hand holding the other forearm low in front of her hips.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme strappy platform stiletto sandals in red leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, with her legs and ankles staying solid carved rich dark walnut wood right down to the shoes.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Ethiopian man in his late 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a fresh-faced boy-group idol face with clear glowing skin, bright eyes and a gentle smile line, clean-shaven, dramatic black smoky eyeshadow with sharp winged eyeliner, smooth medium-brown skin with a warm red undertone, a gentle soft smile, warm auburn red-brown hair styled in wavy, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long bronze chain ending in one large faceted diamond drop, and on the other ear a large bronze hoop carrying five heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on bronze chains of different lengths (a lead barrel-shaped weight, an iron cube-shaped block, a tin pyramid-shaped lump, a silver ship's anchor, a silver square-sided cowbell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and a single mixed-metal ring. Extremely long almond nails, chrome finish studded with crystals.
RIGHT Physique: A tall, extraordinarily well-built athletic man, far beyond any real person in size, built like a fitness model. Broad shoulders, a full athletic chest, a lean defined abdomen with a clear eight-pack, strong toned arms, a narrow waist, and long strong toned legs with defined calves. Large and powerful in frame, yet taut, lean and elegant rather than bulky. His head stays in correct proportion to his frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Body Art: His body carries snake scales (diamond-shaped angular scales aligned in neat overlapping rows), BLAZING PALE GOLD scale formations, VIVID IVORY WHITE scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. It is fused to his own living skin and flexes slightly over every bulge, with no fabric, seam or garment anywhere. It covers his whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of his hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of his feet. His face is left bare and the material fades out at the neck with no hard line.
RIGHT Pose: back three-quarters to camera, head turned back.
RIGHT Footwear: Extreme hot-pink thigh-high stiletto boots with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
